name: Test Research Inc
summary: Test Research, Inc. (TRI) is a global enterprise that designs, engineers, manufactures, services, and distributes automated inspection and testing machinery. Its operations span across Asia, the Americas, Europe, and other international markets. The company's product line includes advanced optical inspection solutions, such as 3D solder paste inspection, automated optical inspection for both pre-reflow and post-reflow stages, and automated X-ray inspection systems. Additionally, TRI manufactures defect analyzers and in-circuit testers. Expanding its offerings, Test Research, Inc. also delivers intelligent factory and AI-driven solutions, along with comprehensive yield management systems. These sophisticated testing and inspection technologies are tailored for key sectors, including the automotive, semiconductor, and telecommunications industries. TRI is committed to extensive after-sales support, which comprises services like troubleshooting, in-depth failure analysis, routine calibration, complete system maintenance, and warranty provisions for parts and accessories. Established in 1989, the company's corporate headquarters are situated in Taipei City, Taiwan.
